data.title: Rebuild /work/software as GIF-first lab gallery (merge wave 2)

data.body: Built GIF-first lab gallery. New: src/components/lab/{LabGallery,LabCard,LabLightbox,LabMedia}.tsx; rewrote src/app/work/software/page.tsx (server component -> getAllWorks() -> <LabGallery>). Verified via pnpm dev + headless Chrome: HTTP 200, all 4 works render newest-first (04->01) with GIFs, lightbox opens (click + Enter/Space, Escape/backdrop close, scroll-lock), repo/live links work, responsive at 375px (1-col) and desktop (2-col). npx tsc --noEmit + eslint clean for touched files. Left staged, no commit. Screenshots captured for Julianna. Open questions for iteration pass: (1) gif autoplay on all cards at once is heavy (~16MB) — consider hover-to-play or IntersectionObserver pause; (2) card hover lift subtle — tune; (3) header eyebrow 'The Lab' + intro copy is a placeholder Julianna may reword; (4) lightbox screenshots strip is implemented but no seeded work uses it yet (fractal-nyc / Agent C will).
